pages.text: The $(l)Lumenwrights$(/l) are gone; only ruins remain. Find broken $(l)Vestige Outposts$(/l), village-sized $(l)Vestige Cities$(/l) (some Grand, with spires), buried $(l)Vaults$(/l), and abandoned $(l)Luminite Mines$(/l) with liftshafts.

Their material is $(l)Glowbrick$(/l), refined from $(l)Luminite$(/l) ore (ore → raw → smelt to ingot → glowbrick). $(l)Memory Crystals$(/l) and $(l)Glyph Tablets$(/l) hold fragments of their story. $(br)$(br)Tip: $(l)/locate structure lumenwilds:vestige_mine$(/l) finds the nearest city with a mineshaft.
